description: This Java class defines the entity OrganisationCreditBureau, representing a credit bureau organization's configuration within the Fineract system. It includes fields such as alias, linked CreditBureau, active status, and associated loan product mappings. It provides constructors, a factory method fromJson, and getters/setters for its fields.

classes.name: OrganisationCreditBureau
classes.description: Entity representing organization-specific credit bureau configuration, including linkage to CreditBureau and loan product mappings.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an OrganisationCreditBureau instance from a JSON command and associated CreditBureau.

methods.name: getAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias of the organization credit bureau.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the organization credit bureau.

methods.name: setCreditBureau
methods.description: Associates a CreditBureau with this entity.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the entity is active.

methods.name: setIsActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the entity.

methods.name: getCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Returns the list of loan product mappings.

methods.name: setCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Sets the list of loan product mappings.
